package.name: anvil_msgs
package.description: Local, minimal reproduction of the two anvil_msgs interfaces this project's HIL-SERL bridge needs (ResetArms.srv, ArmsResetStatus.msg), for cross-machine ROS2 communication with the devbox's real anvil_msgs package. Field content extracted verbatim from the devbox's own built image (docker cp from /workspace/install/anvil_msgs/share/anvil_msgs/) -- NOT the full anvil_msgs package, which also defines unrelated message types (MotorStatus, HardwareState, CanMotorMetric, etc.) this project doesn't use. ROS2's type hash is computed from the IDL-level definition (type + field name + order), not build metadata, so an exact reproduction of just these two files is sufficient for real interop with the devbox's build, not merely a lookalike.
